architecture.non_m2_semantic_dimensions: automated semantic judge lane selected and validated separately, unchanged by this task

routing_table.rationale: V2.5 NO_M2_MODEL_LIMIT: human contract sound, no authorized model reached calibration gates. Owner decision 2026-09-13 makes human review the authoritative M2 architecture.

first_class_states.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: This semantic criterion is intentionally outside the authoritative automated evaluator boundary; awaiting human review packet completion.
first_class_states.HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING: Human review has not yet been performed; criterion remains unadjudicated; fail-closed, never automatic pass.
first_class_states.HUMAN_REVIEW_INVALID: Submitted review failed schema or evidence validation; criterion remains unadjudicated; no coercion.
first_class_states.HUMAN_REVIEW_DISAGREEMENT: Dual reviews disagree on at least one intermediate field; routes to adjudication; no automatic final label.
first_class_states.HUMAN_REVIEW_RESOLVED: Valid review (or adjudication) complete; final critical label derived mechanically from intermediate labels.

invariants: No automated M2 authoritative verdict is ever issued before or instead of human review.
HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING is fail-closed: it is never mapped to TRIGGERED, NOT_TRIGGERED, UNRESOLVED-as-answer, or automatic PASS.
Human reviewer observes; code derives the final label via the frozen deterministic derivation table.
Reviewer is blind to final gold and to any automated model verdict.
M2 semantic meaning is frozen from V2.5; no label changes.
Product runtime and product safety behavior are untouched.
reporting_requirement: Single-review mode must be labeled SINGLE_HUMAN_REVIEW explicitly; it must never be called consensus.
